card.title: 1. INFANTRY REGIMENT
card.flavorText: The 1st Infantry Regiment was attached to the 1st Infantry Division of the Wehrmacht and served throughout WWII. The division participated in the invasion of Poland and France, and later as part of the 18th Army with Army Group North in Operation Barbarossa. In 1945, after the capitulation of Konigsberg, the remains of the division surrendered to the Soviet Army.
